reader_question: What physical source and supporting material make up this version?
form: Treemap grouped by file family and authored/generated/test/document role
boundary: Disk bytes are neither download payload nor labor; generated copies remain separately selectable.

reader_question: Where did recorded source changes concentrate?
unit: added plus deleted text lines per unique nonmerge commit/file
form: Change treemap or date-by-family heatmap with additions/deletions available separately
boundary: Formatting, generated copies and initial imports affect size; commit and PR diff weights are not additive. Distinct nonmerge commit records can repeat patches through squash promotions; SHA deduplication does not deduplicate implementation acts.

reader_question: How did experiments, implementation and accepted references move between branches?
unit: commit parent edge or merged pull-request event
form: Clickable topology and dated PR movement lanes, with selected chapter anchors
boundary: Git parent edges and PR base/head relations are different edge types; current refs omit deleted branch lifetimes.

reader_question: Which kinds of questions occupied the selected collaboration records?
unit: unique Issue or label membership within an explicit corpus
form: Rose chart for disjoint Issue categories or separate label-frequency panels; table companion
meaning: Recorded work categorization at observation time
boundary: Bug is a subset of Issues. Labels overlap; present label memberships separately. Equal-angle polar sector area proportional to count requires radius proportional to square root of count.

reader_question: What changed in the way the team designed, tested and integrated the experience?
form: Clickable scenes connecting direction, alternatives, specimen, correction and receiver
meaning: Documented methodological choices and their outcomes
boundary: Editorial selection is explicit; absent comments do not mean absent review, and attribution requires source evidence.

reader_question: How do the Studio chapters share work while retaining their own controls?
form: System graph with selectable concerns, typed edges and semantic companion
boundary: Reuse the Who to Believe interaction pattern with Studio-owned data; its current graph validator is case-specific.

reader_question: How did a human design correction become a working interaction?
unit: paired preserved artifact or recorded behavior
source: narrative.2026-11-09.json: preserved workbench and dial-lighting records
form: Before/after image, short loop or interactive specimen with a local explanation
boundary: Use comparable captured states; later supplied video and publication remain separate tasks.
